answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The dune of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the jetty is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
